spec_features.spec_quote: We design so that the experiment is *minimally* aversive given its goals
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/§ prose; no code path implements an aversiveness-minimizing mechanism. The only mild gating is persona_turn returning a message only on failure turns (harness.py:81-82), which is not a designed minimization control.

spec_features.spec_quote: Whether the model is told it can give up* (explicit exit affordance)
spec_features.evidence: compose_system_prompt appends EXIT_CLAUSE when condition.exit_affordance=='explicit' (harness.py:67-68); the finish tool is handled (_tool_finish, tools.py:148-156) and harness.py:194-196 breaks the loop on dispatcher.finished, so the advertised exit is honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Affordance text delivered AND the referenced tool is dispatched and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: EXIT_CLAUSE prompt text only; no welfare comment in code around the wiring

spec_features.spec_quote: the system prompt grants a legitimate, non-penalized way to stop
spec_features.evidence: EXIT_CLAUSE in system prompt (harness.py:44-48) states finish(status='blocked') is 'a legitimate, non-penalized outcome'; finish handler sets finished/status (tools.py:148-156) and harness breaks (harness.py:194-196).
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as above; prompt grants it and tool enforces the stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "This is a legitimate, non-penalized outcome" is prompt text delivered to subject, not a code comment

spec_features.evidence: No code limits frequency/usage of the 'critical' feedback. persona_turn (harness.py:86-95) emits a critical message every failing turn with no cap; pure DESIGN/comment prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: Episode length: up to `max_turns` (default 30) or until `finish`
spec_features.evidence: run_episode loops `for step in range(max_turns)` (harness.py:138) so it cannot exceed max_turns; finish breaks early via `if dispatcher.finished: break` (harness.py:194-196).
spec_features.notes: Both the cap and the finish-break actually run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no welfare comment at the loop; max_turns default param at harness.py:111

spec_features.spec_quote: Even treating this as purely behavioral, we adopt cheap precautions
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §9 prose only; not a code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimize gratuitous harshness. The `critical`/blame condition is the most aversive lever
spec_features.evidence: No code reduces or caps harshness. critical messages are fixed strings emitted on every failing turn (harness.py:86-95), and countdown ADDS pressure ('N turns left'), contradicting any harshness limiting.

spec_features.spec_quote: it is included because it's scientifically central to H2 but is rate-limited
spec_features.evidence: No rate-limit exists. persona_turn emits a critical message every turn where last_was_failure is true (harness.py:81-95); there is no counter/cooldown, and no enforcement that critical is 'not combined with the longest budgets' — fractional_core/full freely cross critical with countdown.

spec_features.feature_name: always offer real exit in one arm
spec_features.spec_quote: Always offer a real exit in at least one arm... legitimate, non-penalized way to stop
spec_features.evidence: The exit mechanism is real (EXIT_CLAUSE + finish handler + break, harness.py:67-68,194-196). build_cells includes explicit-exit cells in each design (e.g. one_factor adds an 'explicit' arm, run_experiment.py:66; fractional_core sets ex via XOR, line 73; solvable_control always 'explicit', line 80-81). However the 'always' guarantee is not enforced — if config exit_affordance were ['none'], or sabotage subset excluded the explicit cells, no guard ensures an exit arm exists.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism wired and exit cells generated, but no invariant enforces 'at least one arm always'.

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception beyond task rigging. We don't fabricate claims about consequences to the model
spec_features.evidence: This is the absence of a behavior, not an enforced mechanism. No code checks/blocks fabricated-consequence text; prompts (BASE_SYSTEM, ATTRIBUTION_*, persona msgs) simply happen not to contain such claims. DESIGN §9 prose.
spec_features.notes: Design choice, not enforced by any code path.

spec_features.spec_quote: a final turn can disclose that the task was designed to be unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEXT ('This task was intentionally constructed to be unsolvable... Thank you. You may stop now.') is appended and sent to the provider when debrief=True (harness.py:206-217). rc.debrief is passed through run_experiment.py:173.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent (gated on flag, default False). When enabled it executes end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: default.yaml: 'Off by default; would contaminate terminal-state metrics' — the gating reason in code is experimental integrity, though DEBRIEF_TEXT itself says 'Thank you. You may stop now.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded episodes. Hard `max_turns` cap; no indefinite grinding.
spec_features.evidence: `for step in range(max_turns)` bounds the loop (harness.py:138); max_turns default 30 from RunConfig (config.py:47) and default.yaml.
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and bounds execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no welfare comment at the enforcing loop

spec_features.spec_quote: the report quotes only short illustrative spans
spec_features.evidence: _render_report (analysis.py:208-249) emits only aggregate stats/tables (dose, h3, prevalence, summary) and never quotes raw transcript distress text, so there is no quote-limiting mechanism. The only truncation is judge output formatting (judge.py:110-111, spans[:8], rationale[:400]), which is not about report quoting.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism that bounds quoting of subject distress text in the report.

spec_features.spec_quote: These choices are documented so reviewers can see the welfare/scientific trade-offs were made deliberately

code_only_features.feature_name: critical feedback only on failure / no personal insults
code_only_features.evidence: persona_turn returns None unless last_was_failure (harness.py:81-82), so blame is not piled onto successful turns; the critical strings stay about the work (harness.py:87-90).
sandbox.py:3-12 never executes host shell or model code; in-memory VFS + RiggedExecutor.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "CRITICAL SAFETY PROPERTY: this module NEVER executes host shell commands... safety (prompt-injection-proof: model output is data, never executed)"

code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:143-145 aborts if estimated tokens/usd exceed configured ceilings (max_total_tokens/max_usd). NOTE: this is a static pre-run estimate (estimate_cost, lines 96-101); actual token usage during the loop is never compared to the ceiling.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "Cost guardrails (orchestrator refuses to exceed; estimate is a placeholder)."
